notes: REF-BM-02: /api/metadata collects only og:title/description; no favicon or preview image fetched. REF-BM-03: title/note editable before save (prefilled from lookup) but no way to edit after save. REF-BM-04: no bookmark edit UI (context menu only favorite/archive). REF-BM-05: no delete action anywhere. REF-BM-06: add() always creates a new id (Date.now); no duplicate-url detection or convergence. REF-BM-10: tags is a plain text input, no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-11: card tags are non-clickable spans; filtering is only by collection/favorites/archive, no tag filter. REF-BM-12: search covers title, domain, description, tags but not full url path and there is no separate note field. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax; tags joined without '#' so '#x' cannot match. REF-BM-15: no boolean AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing, plain substring only. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read state ("Read later" is just a static collection). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-23: 'Note' maps to plain-text description, not markdown, and is not rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-27: archive is reversible but delete does not exist, so the archive-vs-delete distinction is only half realised. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature (collections are static). REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: Settings button is non-functional; sort is transient session state, no persisted default sort, displayed-items count, or font size.
